check: Each agent has its own workload identity
how_to_test: List identities in the IdP/secret store; none shared between agents

check: No shared or human service accounts used by agents
how_to_test: Search tool-call logs for human or shared principals

check: Credentials are short-lived
how_to_test: Check token lifetime and rotation config

check: The human the agent acts for is recorded on each action
how_to_test: Pick 5 actions; each names agent and on-behalf-of user

check: Tokens are scoped per tool and bound to one audience (no passthrough of the caller's token)
how_to_test: Decode a token; check audience and scopes

check: Human approvers are identified and authorized for what they approve
how_to_test: Check approver role mapping

check: Policy is code in version control
how_to_test: Find the repo and last 5 changes

check: Default is deny
how_to_test: Call a tool with no matching rule

check: Every tool call is evaluated before it executes
how_to_test: Trace one call end to end; policy decision precedes execution

check: Policy has automated tests in CI
how_to_test: Run the test suite; check it gates merges

check: New policy runs in shadow mode before it enforces
how_to_test: Check last policy rollout for a shadow period

check: Policy changes need review and are logged
how_to_test: Check approval + audit entry for last change

check: Outbound destinations are allowlisted
how_to_test: Attempt a call to a non-listed host

check: Unknown hosts are blocked and alerted
how_to_test: Check alert fired for the attempt

check: Data classes (personal data) are labeled and checked on the way out
how_to_test: Send a labeled record to a non-approved tool

check: Code execution runs in a sandbox with no ambient credentials
how_to_test: Inspect sandbox config

check: Secrets never appear in prompts or context
how_to_test: Scan prompts and traces for secret patterns

check: Outputs are checked before they reach external systems
how_to_test: Check output filter or review step

check: One correlated record per action (prompt + principal + tool call + result)
how_to_test: Pick an action; fetch all four with one trace ID

check: Records are append-only and tamper-evident
how_to_test: Check signing or hash chaining

check: Denials are logged as fully as successes
how_to_test: Find a denied action in the log

check: Approvals and approver identity are in the record
how_to_test: Pick an approved action

check: Retention is set to the longest rule that applies to you
how_to_test: Compare retention setting with your rule list

check: One query can replay an incident
how_to_test: Time a replay of last week's decision

check: Per-agent spend budget with alert
how_to_test: Check budget and alert threshold

check: Per-tool rate limits
how_to_test: Exceed the limit in test

check: Maximum steps or loop depth per task
how_to_test: Trigger a loop in test

check: Blast-radius limit per action (records or amount)
how_to_test: Try an action above the limit

check: Concurrency limit per agent
how_to_test: Run parallel calls above the cap

check: Cost is attributed to team/agent/task
how_to_test: Pull a cost report by agent

check: Any single agent can be disabled in minutes
how_to_test: Time a disable in test

check: All agents can be disabled at once
how_to_test: Run a global stop in test

check: Credentials can be revoked fast
how_to_test: Revoke and confirm calls fail

check: System fails closed if the policy engine is down
how_to_test: Stop the engine; call a tool

check: A named owner is on call for each agent
how_to_test: Check the owner list and rota

check: The kill switch is drilled on a schedule
how_to_test: Check last drill date
